## One-round compaction v2 support

- **PiTTy now understands the current `pi-one-round-compaction` protocol.** Live progress from `pi-one-round-compaction.progress.v2` renders the new `audit` and `execution` lanes instead of falling through as raw machine-readable status JSON.
- **Completion details v6 are preserved.** PiTTy reads the current lane timings, retained-turn/boundary metadata, Git/file state, durable-source provenance, target/effective budgets, and the derived `laneOutputBudgetTokens` value.
- **No current intent/workflow assumptions.** Progress v2 rejects the removed `mode` and `intentWorkflow` fields, and details v6 accepts only the current `audit` + `execution` shape.
- **Older sessions still render.** Historical progress v1 and details v2/v4 remain readable behind their original versioned parsers, without leaking those legacy concepts into the current protocol.

## Validation

- TypeScript typecheck passed.
- Focused compaction parser/render suite: **127 passed, 0 failed**.
- A complete local suite run retained two unrelated environment/baseline failures which both reproduce on untouched `origin/main`; the release workflow remains the authoritative publish gate.
